mapper.sql: f.id, f.tenant_id, f.create_user_id, f.create_time, f.update_user_id, f.update_time, f.deleted_at, f.version, f.resource_id, f.version_id, f.usage_id, f.reporter_credential_id, f.biz_code, f.env_code, f.app_code, f.outcome, f.explicit_score, f.judge_score, f.judge_state, f.judge_attempts, f.judge_lease_until, f.judged_at, f.judge_error, f.input_excerpt, f.output_excerpt, f.latency_ms, f.occurred_at, f.trace_id

SELECT , v.version_no AS version_no FROM ddc_ai_usage_feedback f LEFT JOIN ddc_ai_version v ON v.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND v.resource_id = f.resource_id AND v.id = f.version_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WHERE f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.explicit_score, f.judge_score) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_count, SUM(COALESCE(f.explicit_score, f.judge_score)) AS score_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN f.judge_state IN ('PENDING', 'JUDGING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_judge_count FROM ddc_ai_usage_feedback f WHERE f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND f.version_id = #{versionId} AND f.occurred_at >= #{windowStart} AND f.occurred_at < #{windowEnd}
ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM ddc_ai_usage_feedback f LEFT JOIN ddc_ai_version v ON v.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND v.resource_id = f.resource_id AND v.id = f.version_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ddc_ai_usage_feedback SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', version = version + 1, update_user_id = #{et.updateUserId}, update_time = #{et.updateTime} WHERE tenant_id = #{et.tenantId} AND id = #{et.id} AND version = #{et.version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
